title: Rate limits key on real server functions only
why: The RPC and form rate-limit map was keyed by client-chosen text: unknown or megabyte-long function names grew it by hundreds of megabytes, and a form id with a suffix (`hash/login/1`) ran `login` under a fresh 60-per-minute budget.
changelog: a form's `_brain` id must be exactly `<hash>/<name>`; anything else answers 400 and never runs the function
RPC and form rate limits count only a function that exists, keyed by `<hash>/<name>` and the client address; unknown names answer 404/400 without a rate-limit entry
the rate-limit map is capped at 50 000 entries (oldest window first) and long keys are stored as a digest
